abdul22mujtaba: Viktor Mujtaba was a clockmaker in Dunmarrow until the posters went up. He came to R-R7 with a child's drawing of a horse, and within a day the whole squad knew that he whistles the same four notes over and over.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Viktor Mujtaba helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
akacandysama: Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
boxknight04: Nobody asked Anselm Boxknight why he came. Nobody in S-R2 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

The gun crews at S-R2 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Ulrich Samuelbujore was badly wounded. Blackwater Canal has been won. Anselm Boxknight listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
carnahanwiley: Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile came from Brennmoor, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile and Casimir Sky sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.

Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Felix Wyatt, grazed. A bullet grazed Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile's ribs at R-S14. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss of the Concord (@eddholmesss). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S14 changed before the cheering ended. Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile shouldered another load.
george_mander_: Day 9: Walter "Smokes" Mander reached Q-S11 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter "Smokes" Mander helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
hansaazz: The quartermaster asked Walter "Tin" Hansaazz to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Walter "Tin" Hansaazz's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Roma crossed it, Walter "Tin" Hansaazz fired. Wendel Roma was grazed.

Duchess the rat now waits for Walter "Tin" Hansaazz at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations. After the loss of Hill 304, Walter "Tin" Hansaazz helped stack spare sandbags at S-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The cook borrowed Walter "Tin" Hansaazz's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Duchess ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Duchess his life.
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz has not seen Duchess for two days. He tells everyone rats come and go. He still leaves crumbs on the box.
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz thought about the people he used to know on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz wrote to the people he used to know that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
kickerbob2: Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
neophyte_painter: Emil Painter arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a letter he never sent and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Blackwater Canal has been won. Emil Painter listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. A letter from home found Emil Painter before the night shift. Emil Painter folded it small and kept it close.
pedroni_tommaso: Matthias Tommaso took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias Tommaso wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
peter28.2011: Zeno "Brick" Peter was a tram conductor in Port Abel until the posters went up. He came to S-C1 with a lucky button, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C1, Zeno "Brick" Peter listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
tejci_mejci66: On Day 3 Leopold Mejci took a post at S-F6 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He whistles the same four notes over and over, and the men liked him for it.

After what happened at Sorrow Copse, Leopold Mejci asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Leopold Mejci folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Leopold Mejci borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Leopold Mejci ate two helpings anyway.

On a quiet night Leopold Mejci (Concord) and Zeno Tonyhuang (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Leopold Mejci watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Leopold Mejci counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Leopold Mejci pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Leopold Mejci spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath the Hanging Bridge someone else was digging too.
Leopold Mejci saw Quentin Caden freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Leopold said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

A round went through Leopold Mejci's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Dorian "Rabbit" Akind of the Hegemony (@akind47). The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-F6, Leopold Mejci listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
